en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course is a continuation of Design Creation Techniques I. The aim of the course is to independently master the design of a furniture item (table furniture), including graphic outputs and drawing documentation.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to the subject and familiarization with its content (allowance 0/3)2.Furniture solitaire (table furniture) (allowance 0/36) a.Assignment: Design and realization of a furniture item (table furniture).b.Introduction to the issue, input data and solution requirements with a focus on the given issue.c.Analysis of the current market offer from the point of view of history, research, typology.d.Design of various solution options focusing on construction and material, technology, ergonomics, safety and product design.e.Graphic solution - visualization (views + perspective)f.Technical solution (drawing documentation)3.Defense and evaluation of the proposal (allowance 0/3)
